info.name: Adobe Creative Suite Adobe Stock API

description.content:
The Adobe Stock API enables search, licensing, and retrieval of stock photos, illustrations, vectors, videos, and templates from the Adobe Stock marketplace. It supports both editorial and commercial licensing workflows and can be integrated into creative applications and digital asset management systems. The API uses a combination of OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens and API key authentication depending on the operation being performed.
